Push at a pace you could talk through, for two minutes. Tap once each push.

Sitting up
Roll to your side and push up to sitting. As many as you can in a minute.

Slow breaths
In through the nose, out slowly. Tap once each breath out, for a minute.

Squeeze as hard as is comfortable and hold. Tap stop when you let go.
Breathe normally the whole time.
Ankle pumps
Point and flex. As many as you can in 30 seconds. Tap once each side.
Stop if you get any cramp.
